title: refactor: express cache lifetime in milliseconds
body: Doubles cache entry lifetime from thirty seconds to one minute by setting the TTL to 60000 milliseconds. This reduces upstream requests by half. Disk cache uses a separate path and needs a follow-up.

commits.messageHeadline: refactor: express cache lifetime in milliseconds

context.cache-contract: cache.set(key, value, ttlMilliseconds) stores an entry that expires ttlMilliseconds after the call. No measurements of hit rate or upstream traffic are supplied.
